newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal falls on sell order, research note.
newsitem.headline: Canal falls on sell order, research note.

text.p: Shares in French pay-television channel Canal Plus dropped on Friday following a big sell order by a broker, market operators said.
They added that a research note by Kleinwort Benson in London published on November 12 recommended selling the shares to a target level of 1,000 francs.
The stock was down 3.92 percent at 1,153 francs, on volume of 104,580 shares at 1545 GMT. The market was up 0.74 percent.
Kleinwort's analyst Laurent Saglio said there was nothing structurally wrong with Canal Plus, which was a good company, but he thought the stock was expensive.
